term.name: query_binding
term.definition: The language of a Schematron schema's expressions, its queryBinding attribute, compared ignoring case: sxml reads xslt, xslt4, xpath, xpath4 and a schema without one as XSLT 4.0 and XPath 4.0, and xslt2, xslt3, xpath2, xpath3 and xpath31 on the same 4.0 processor; every other binding is schematron:query-binding ( as amended, )
